sections.label: About this place
sections.title: Why HarkerX Harbor?
sections.content:
HarkerX Harbor is a personal space for recording thoughts, experiences, projects, and things worth keeping.

I started writing online in 2023. Over time, the site has changed along with me, but the purpose has stayed simple: to keep a place for ideas that deserve more than a passing thought.

Most of the site is a blog, but it also serves as a home for projects, experiments, notes, and anything else I find interesting enough to build or document.

The site will keep evolving over time. The goal is not to make it perfect, but to make it useful, personal, and worth coming back to.
